001package dayplanner;
002
003import javax.swing.JComboBox;
004
005/**
006 * Represents the Swing GUI combo box to select a command.
007 */
008public class GUICommandMenu extends JComboBox<String> {
009    private static final String[] OPTIONS = {
010        "< Select a Command >",
011        "Add - Insert a new activity",
012        "Search - Search for an activity",
013        "Quit - Exit DayPlanner" };
014
015
016    /**
017     * Create a new Swing GUI picker.
018     * 
019     * @param gdp        Refers to the Swing GUI window.
020     * @param activities Instantiated ActivityList.
021     */
022    public GUICommandMenu(GUIDayPlanner gdp, ActivityList activities) {
023        super(OPTIONS);
024
025        addActionListener(e -> {
026            MenuOption option = MenuOption.parse(getSelectedIndex());
027            
028            // Execute the desired task.
029            switch (option) {
030                case ADD:
031                    new GUIAddWindow(activities);
032                    break;
033                case SEARCH:
034                    break;
035                case QUIT:
036                    new GUIQuitMenu(gdp);
037                    break;
038                default:
039                    break;
040            }
041
042            // Immediately show the "Select Command" item.
043            setSelectedIndex(0);
044        });
045    }
046}
